purpose: Test whether noise inputs cost accuracy because the same noise repeats in every training epoch (and so can help to remember the training labels), by drawing new noise in every epoch.
claim_boundary: Exploratory for BCI IV 2a, planned after its test results and after the input-cost, penalty and pretraining results were known. For Lee2019 the predictions are fixed before any of these models is scored on Lee2019 session 2; three predictions, no correction for multiplicity. It explains a result; it does not change the frozen 2a configuration.

F1.claim: Noise that never repeats costs less than noise that repeats in every epoch
F1.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: fresh-46 minus relevance-16-plus-46 (scripts/input_cost_study.py)

F2.claim: Noise that never repeats has no visible cost
F2.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: fresh-46 minus relevance-16
F2.test: interval lower bound above -2 points (as K1 of scripts/input_kind_study.py)

F3.claim: The network turns noise that never repeats down
F3.contrast: Lee2019 final models: noise-to-electrode weight ratio (RMS of the effective spatial weights, mibci.noise_mechanism.weight_rms), fresh-46 minus relevance-16-plus-46, per participant
F3.test: interval upper bound below 0; whether the fresh models' median ratio falls below 1/3 is also reported

readings.F1 and F2 hold: explanation A: the network would ignore useless inputs; recorded noise is kept because within one day it helps to remember the training set, so methods that only see the training set cannot tell it from a useful electrode; data beyond the training set (choosing electrodes first, pretraining) can
readings.F1 does not hold: not the remembering of noise: even noise that never repeats is not switched off; the problem is optimization or architecture (read with the long-training curves)
readings.F1 holds, F2 does not: both explanations contribute; report the measured shares

references.fixed: relevance-16-plus-k of scripts/input_cost_study.py: the same inputs with the noise drawn once (draw 0)

fresh_noise: every epoch, every training trial: white noise through the preprocessing band-pass after a 2-s warm-up, divided by its gain (unit variance), numpy seed [694, dataset code, participant, split code, model seed, epoch]; standardized with the fixed-noise models' statistics (draw 0 of the training trials)
scored_inputs: identical to scripts/input_cost_study.py: draw 0 for the held-out runs and session 2
analysis: seeds (and folds) averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free session-2 trials, Lee2019 on all; 2a also with the seed error
